debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-f-t-e-d f-a-l-s-e p-r-o-v-e-n-a-n-c-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s for the c-a-s-e and left the o-r-i-g-i-n-a-l t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e-s on f-i-l-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-r-s-i-o-n c-o-n-t-r-o-l c-h-e-c-k.
2) the a-c-t-o-r m-i-n-e-d p-u-b-l-i-c s-a-l-e-s l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s to c-o-m-p-i-l-e fake o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p h-i-s-t-o-r-i-e-s and left the c-r-a-w-l-e-d s-c-r-a-p-e d-a-t-a on f-i-l-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-a-t-a l-i-n-e-a-g-e r-e-v-i-e-w.
3) the a-c-t-o-r c-r-e-a-t-e-d c-l-o-n-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s mimicking p-e-r-m-i-t s-e-r-i-a-l-n-u-m-b-e-r-s and left the d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e p-d-f-s on f-i-l-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
4) the a-c-t-o-r p-u-b-l-i-s-h-e-d d-e-c-e-p-t-i-v-e w-e-b s-t-o-r-a-g-e a-d-s and left the a-d-v-e-r-t-i-s-i-n-g a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s on f-i-l-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-n-t-e-n-t m-o-d-e-r-a-t-i-o-n l-o-g r-e-v-i-e-w.
5) the a-c-t-o-r i-g-n-o-r-e-d w-i-l-d-l-i-f-e s-t-a-t-u-t-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t-s and left the i-g-n-o-r-e-d a-l-e-r-t n-o-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n-s on f-i-l-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e r-e-p-o-r-t i-n-g e-s-t-e-p.
